definitions: Spaces within a building or complex that are shared by all residents or users, rather than being private to one individual or family.
Shared facilities or spaces in a residential or public building, such as lounges, kitchens, or gardens, intended for use by all occupants.
examples: The communal areas of the building are cleaned daily.
Residents are responsible for keeping the communal areas tidy.
The new development features extensive communal areas including a gym and a roof terrace.
